method: sha256 obtained from Hugging Face LFS pointers (authoritative content-address oids) and cross-verified against two independently downloaded local copies of the checkpoint; the config hash is the sha256 of the raw remote file bytes. Only assets with a live download URL have entries -- the 8 registry models whose TRvlvr fallback URLs are dead (404, audited 2026-07-12) cannot be hashed until a live mirror is found.
